A day/night cycle. Add it to one object (a controller, can be invisible). It dims the scene at night and brightens it by day, and sets the variables isDay/isNight/timeOfDay you can read in the AI or in blocks (e.g. spawn certain enemies only at night). 'True black darkness' makes the dark pure black (no night tint) and fully dark underground. Lighting style: Smooth = soft circles of light; Blocks = light computed block by block (each Light then chooses whether solid blocks stop it, whether it colours what it touches and whether it adds up with other lights). Works for Top-down and Platformer.

A grid of tiles you paint in the editor (ground, walls, level geometry). Solid tiles become collision automatically. Add it to an empty object, then paint with the Tiles panel.
